channel.title: Robotics Directory - Smart Home Robots
channel.description: Browse 79 smart home robots in the Robotics Directory. Specs, prices, images and comparison.

item.title: Amazon Ring Drone Cam
item.description: Ring Drone Cam is Ring's flying indoor security camera, announced on 10 November 2026. Its AI Pilot system maps the home, suggests patrol points and flies autonomously around obstacles. It records 2K video with a 148° field of view, can rotate 360° and has built-in LED lights for low-light recording. Between flights it powers down in its dock with the camera off and records only once a flight is triggered. Scheduled flights require a compatible Ring Protect plan. US availability is 27 January 2027 at 249.99 USD. Amazon publishes no flight time, mass, dimensions or charging time.
